{{Quote|When I wish to read the ancient ''Sith writings''&hellip;I wear '''this'''.|King Ommin, describing one of his Sith amulets|<ref name="nadd2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]]</ref>}}
A '''Sith talisman''', sometimes known as a '''Sith amulet''', was a powerful [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] used to amplify the effects of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]]. Sith amulets resembled jewelry, and were usually worn around the neck or hand in a medallion or gauntlet style respectively. These "baubles" were used by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] to channel immense [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] power.

==Description==
{{Quote|The Sith Lords use it for focusing their powers somehow&mdash;|[[Jori Daragon]]|<ref name="fall2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:TranslationTalisman-TFNU2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|One of King Ommin's many Sith amulets.]]

Sith amulets could grant the wielder the ability to read and understand ancient Sith text, which was how [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]] learned to read the Sith magic book he stole.<ref name="nadd2" /> In combat, Sith amulets were capable of channeling dark side power into beams of lethal energy to be blasted outwards from the wielder's hand.<ref name="dark6">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 6|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 6]]</ref> Some amulets were protective, such as the [[Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger]],<ref name="Vindication3">[[Knights of the Old Republic 34|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 34]]</ref> or talismans which could repel weapons fire, Force effects, or even lightsabers depending on the focus and strength of the wearer.<ref name="DSSB">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> The Sith amulet of Lord [[Rin Shuuir]] could be used to heal grave wounds.<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> Sith amulets could generate images like a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]]; [[Gav Daragon]] once used an amulet given to him by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] to record a message with Force-projected images for his sister [[Jori Daragon|Jori]],<ref name="golden4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> and [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] applied this ability to show his group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] defectors a Force-projected image of how Kun destroyed the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Freedon Nadd]].<ref name="TSW1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 1]]</ref>

An amulet belonging to the Dark Lord of the Sith [[Skere Kaan|Kaan]] ended up being integrated into the [[Glove of Darth Vader|glove]] of the later Dark Lord [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> The [[Amulet of Kalara]] was another Sith amulet, found by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], whose powers and abilities were unknown.<ref name="Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|See for yourself. This ancient Jedi amulet tells all.|Exar Kun, lying about his Sith amulet|<ref name="TSW1" />}}
Sith amulets were popular during the days of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. [[Karness Muur]], a member of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]], was gifted his own unique amulet, the [[Muur Talisman]], by his fellow ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Sorzus Syn]],<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> an amulet in which his spirit resided after his physical death.<ref name="kotor27">[[Knights of the Old Republic 27|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 27]]</ref> Later Sith Lords of the [[Golden Age of the Sith]] such as [[Ludo Kressh]] and Naga Sadow also wore Sith amulets<ref name="golden2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref> to amplify their power.<ref name="dark4" />

<div style="float:right">[[File:ExarKunSithAmulet-TheSithWar1.jpg|thumb|180px|Exar Kun brandishes his Sith amulet.]]</div>

King Ommin of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] owned numerous Sith amulets, one of which he wore occasionally around his neck. In [[3998 BBY]], Ommin gifted another of his amulets to the future [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] leader Satal Keto,<ref name="nadd2" /> which was later acquired by the then- [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] Ulic Qel-Droma.<ref name="dark6" /> Exar Kun also acquired Naga Sadow's ancient amulet from [[Zythmnr]]. Kun then used the amulet to vanquish Freedon Nadd's spirit, as well as the ancient [[Sith wyrm]] inhabiting the [[Temple of Fire]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="dark4" /> It was later discovered that the amulet in Kun's possession was the mate of Qel-Droma's. Thus, while the pair [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Exar Kun)|dueled]] in the Krath's [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Iron Citadel]], their amulets recognized each other and sprang to life. Spirits of ancient Sith Lords suddenly appeared, among whom was the spectre of the Dark Lord [[Marka Ragnos]], who declared Kun and Qel-Droma the harbingers of a new Sith-ruled empire.<ref name="dark6" />
